theme: 并购重组与资本市场核心术语

words.collins_def: A public offer to buy shares from existing shareholders of a company at a specified price during a set time period, usually in an effort to acquire control of the company.
words.pron_tip: 注意 tender 发 /ˈtendər/，勿与 tinder 混淆

examples.en: The acquirer launched a tender offer to purchase 100% of the target's outstanding shares at a 30% premium to the market price.
examples.cn: 收购方发起要约收购，拟以较市价溢价30%的价格购买目标公司全部流通股份。

words.collins_def: An acquisition of one company by another against the wishes of the target company's management and board of directors.
words.pron_tip: hostile 重音在前 /ˈhɒstaɪl/，切勿读成 /hɒˈstaɪl/

examples.en: The board adopted a poison pill strategy to fend off the hostile takeover bid from the corporate raider.
examples.cn: 董事会采取了毒丸策略，以抵御企业狙击手的敌意收购要约。

words.collins_def: An intangible asset that arises when a buyer acquires an existing business for more than the fair value of its net identifiable assets, often reflecting brand reputation or customer relationships.
words.pron_tip: 由 good + will 构成，但在会计与并购中专指无形资产“商誉”

examples.en: The transaction resulted in $500 million of goodwill being recorded on the acquirer's balance sheet.
examples.cn: 该交易导致收购方资产负债表上记入了5亿美元的商誉。

words.collins_def: A contractual obligation of one party to compensate another for losses or damages arising from breaches of representations, warranties, or covenants.
words.pron_tip: 分段记忆 in-dem-ni-fi-ca-tion，重音在 ca 音节

examples.en: The seller agreed to provide indemnification for any tax liabilities arising from pre-closing periods.
examples.cn: 卖方同意就交割前期间产生的任何税务责任提供赔偿。

words.collins_def: A significant negative impact on a company's business, assets, financial condition, or results of operations that permits a buyer to withdraw from or renegotiate a transaction.
words.pron_tip: 缩写 MAE 在交易文件中极为常见，material 此处指“重大的”

examples.en: The buyer argued that the pandemic constituted a material adverse effect, allowing it to terminate the merger agreement.
examples.cn: 买方主张疫情构成了重大不利影响，使其有权终止合并协议。

words.collins_def: A legal arrangement in which a neutral third party temporarily holds assets or documents on behalf of transacting parties until specified conditions are met.
words.pron_tip: es-crow，词尾发音为 /oʊ/，不要读出 w 的音

examples.en: Ten percent of the purchase price was placed in escrow to secure the seller's indemnification obligations.
examples.cn: 购买价格的10%被置于托管账户，以担保卖方的赔偿义务。

words.collins_def: A contractual period after an initial public offering or acquisition during which certain shareholders are prohibited from selling their shares.
words.pron_tip: lock-up 作形容词性复合词，重音落在 lock

examples.en: Pre-IPO investors agreed to a 180-day lock-up period following the company's listing on the exchange.
examples.cn: 上市前投资者同意在公司挂牌后遵守180天的锁定期。

words.collins_def: A provision that enables a majority shareholder to force minority shareholders to join in the sale of a company on the same terms and conditions.
words.pron_tip: 字面“拖拽同行”，形象表示大股东可“拖着”小股东一起出售公司

examples.en: The venture capital firm exercised its drag-along right to compel the founders to sell their shares in the exit transaction.
examples.cn: 风险投资机构行使其领售权，强制创始人在退出交易中一同出售股份。

words.collins_def: Describing financial statements prepared to reflect a hypothetical transaction or event as if it had occurred at an earlier date, used for illustrative or comparative purposes.
words.pron_tip: 源自拉丁语，pro 发 /proʊ/，forma 发 /ˈfɔːrmə/

examples.en: The issuer presented pro forma financials showing the combined results of the two entities post-merger.
examples.cn: 发行人提交了备考财务报表，展示两家实体合并后的模拟业绩。

words.collins_def: A professional evaluation by a financial advisor stating whether the financial terms of a proposed transaction are fair to shareholders from a financial point of view.
words.pron_tip: fairness 注意 /eə/ 双元音，opinion 重音在第二音节

examples.en: The special committee obtained a fairness opinion from an independent investment bank before recommending the buyout.
examples.cn: 特别委员会在建议接受收购方案前，从独立投资银行获取了公允性意见。
